remarks: Welcome to 147 Stevens St in Lockport! This affordable and well-maintained home has so much to offer! Featuring 3 bedrooms and 1 full bath, this charming home offers a convenient first-floor bedroom, a formal dining room, and an eat-in kitchen with updated flooring, a mudroom, and easy access to the fully fenced backyard. Enjoy outdoor gatherings on the patio and the convenience of a detached 2-car garage! Upstairs, you'll find two great sized bedrooms with ample closet space. The full basement offers additional storage, an area perfect for a home office and a laundry room for your convenience. Additional updates include a freshly painted interior, mostly replaced windows, a roof approximately 16 years old, a Goodman furnace and hot water tank in good condition, basement waterproofing completed by previous owners, and updated 150-amp electrical service. Ideally located near Lockport's historic Erie Canal, shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences! Whether you're a first-time homebuyer or looking to downsize, this home offers great value and endless possibilities. Don't miss this opportunity to make this house your home!
